Troubleshooting · 02/50 · planning

Uncontrolled scope drift

Failure signal

A uncontrolled scope drift condition is reported or detected during planning.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for planning does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Diff every new request against the approved deliverable list and assumptions.

Corrective action

Log the delta, owner, cost and schedule effect; approve or remove it explicitly.

Prevention

Add this verification to the planning gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
